The guest name 'Marina Mogilko' runs across the top in a huge black condensed italic serif, partly hidden behind her head (text-behind-subject). 'Entrepreneur' sits small beneath. Mid-frame, tiny spaced caps 'YOU · SAID · A' float above a lime-green italic serif 'gap between'.
observed.typography: Display: very condensed, high-contrast italic serif in black, editorial-magazine style. Accent: lime green (#A6E35A-ish) italic serif with a slight glow. Micro caps are tiny, white, and spread wide across the phrase width.
observed.composition: Name spans nearly the full width at the top third, behind the head. The accent phrase sits at chest height. Micro words are distributed across the width above the accent, like a ruler.
observed.lighting_effects: Natural daylight scene. The lime text has a soft glow for legibility against the white blazer.
observed.depth_layering: Three planes: background window, then the name text, then the subject (matted in front), then the caption in front of everything. The defining technique is subject segmentation.

inferred.animation: INFERRED: the name slides up from behind the shoulder line or tracks in from 0.2em to 0 spacing while staying occluded by the subject. The accent appears on the spoken word. A slow 2-3% push-in on the footage over the shot adds depth.
inferred.use_cases: Guest introductions with a magazine feel, opening shots, and bright, airy footage where dark overlays would look heavy.
inferred.recreation: Needs a subject matte: rembg/U2Net/RobustVideoMatting per frame, or a manual roto. Composite order: plate, then the name text, then the subject cut-out, then the caption. Name font: a condensed italic display serif (e.g. 'Bodoni Moda Italic' condensed via transform: scaleX(.8)). Check the matte edge quality at hair.

references.notes: Low-resolution source (115x193). The serif family is approximate.
